name: letrot.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 12 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.
lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.
summary: www.letrot.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: 12 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.

fix.title: 12 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /courses/aujourd-hui, /courses/programme/2026-10-24/2006, /courses/programme/2026-10-24/1304, /courses/programme/2026-10-24/1475 and 8 more. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /courses/aujourd-hui, /actualites, for example #button-addon. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies userid on hexaglobe.net, sessionid on hexaglobe.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 16 elements on /, /courses/aujourd-hui, /actualites, for example a[href$="#menu"] and .swiper-slide > a[target="_blank"][rel="noopener"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Form elements must have labels
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /courses/aujourd-hui, for example .sr-only. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / WebSite lacks name, /courses/aujourd-hui WebSite lacks name, /actualites WebSite lacks name and 17 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
